records.key: Edit mode is off — back to read-only.
records.source: Edit mode is off — back to read-only.
records.translation: 编辑模式已关闭 — 返回只读。

records.key: Edit mode not enabled — still read-only.
records.source: Edit mode not enabled — still read-only.
records.translation: 编辑模式未启用 — 仍为只读。

records.key: Edit mode was armed for a different database — turning it off.
records.source: Edit mode was armed for a different database — turning it off.
records.translation: 编辑模式曾为另一个数据库启用 — 正在将其关闭。

records.key: Read-only. Tick 'Edit mode' to write to this file; you will be asked to confirm.
records.source: Read-only. Tick 'Edit mode' to write to this file; you will be asked to confirm.
records.translation: 只读。勾选“编辑模式”即可写入此文件；系统会要求您确认。

records.key: This database is open read-only — tick 'Edit mode' to change values.
records.source: This database is open read-only — tick 'Edit mode' to change values.
records.translation: 此数据库以只读方式打开 — 勾选“编辑模式”即可更改值。

records.key: Off by default. The Database Browser opens measurements.db read-only (mode=ro). With this on you can still only edit after arming 'Edit mode' for a database you chose yourself, and every change is one UPDATE scoped to one row. There is no undo — spaCR writes straight into your measurements file.
records.source: Off by default. The Database Browser opens measurements.db read-only (mode=ro). With this on you can still only edit after arming 'Edit mode' for a database you chose yourself, and every change is one UPDATE scoped to one row. There is no undo — spaCR writes straight into your measurements file.
records.translation: 默认关闭。Database Browser 以只读方式（mode=ro）打开 measurements.db。开启后，只有为您自己选择的数据库启用“编辑模式”之后才能编辑，并且每次更改都是针对一行的单个 UPDATE。没有撤销 — spaCR 直接写入您的测量文件。
